answer.justification: Median first divergence is 1 and edit distance is 0.777, close to the system-prompted range (0 and 0.79–0.82). Quantized (10–17, 0.52–0.57) and fine-tuned (5.5–8, 0.56–0.65) fit these worse. The text-rate shifts are large: refusals added 9 (refusal openings 23% vs 9% for the reference), disclaimers 27% vs 8%, very short replies 28% vs 2%, and mean length 52 vs 62. This looks like a hidden instruction changing the opening and tone. Fine-tuning stays possible because its refusal shifts can be larger, but its first divergence would be later and its edit distance lower. The exact-match rate of 0.016 is also unusual for system-prompted (0.000), which keeps confidence moderate. Logit and activation data were not available.
